detached_structure.evidence: A small brownish rectangular structure sits at the edge of the lawn right of the house, near the trees. It could be a shed, but it is partly hidden by canopy.

signals.notes: The central house is a multi-gable home with brown shingle roofs, partly shaded and surrounded by dense mature trees, with a lawn behind it. A pool is visible on the neighboring lot to the right, not on this one.
